name: web: comment on D3 publishes an inline draft
sql: INSERT INTO phabricator_differential.differential_transaction_comment (phid, transactionPHID, authorPHID, viewPolicy, editPolicy, commentVersion, content, contentSource, isDeleted, dateCreated, dateModified, revisionPHID, changesetID, isNewFile, lineNumber, lineLength, fixedState, hasReplies, replyToCommentPHID, attributes) SELECT 'PHID-XCMT-paritydraft00001', NULL, u.phid, 'public', u.phid, 1, 'What about FasterMake?', '{"source":"web","params":[]}', 0, 1, 1, '{D3}', c.id, 1, 7, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, '{"inline.state":{"text":"What about","hasSuggestion":false,"suggestionText":""},"editing":false}' FROM phabricator_user.user u, phabricator_differential.differential_changeset c JOIN phabricator_differential.differential_diff d ON d.id = c.diffID JOIN phabricator_differential.differential_revision r ON r.id = d.revisionID AND r.activeDiffPHID = d.phid WHERE u.userName = 'alice' AND r.id = 3 LIMIT 1

name: web: an inline draft alone on D3
sql: INSERT INTO phabricator_differential.differential_transaction_comment (phid, transactionPHID, authorPHID, viewPolicy, editPolicy, commentVersion, content, contentSource, isDeleted, dateCreated, dateModified, revisionPHID, changesetID, isNewFile, lineNumber, lineLength, fixedState, hasReplies, replyToCommentPHID, attributes) SELECT 'PHID-XCMT-paritydraft00001', NULL, u.phid, 'public', u.phid, 1, 'nit: a message.', '{"source":"legacy","params":[]}', 0, 1, 1, '{D3}', c.id, 0, 7, 1, NULL, 0, NULL, '[]' FROM phabricator_user.user u, phabricator_differential.differential_changeset c JOIN phabricator_differential.differential_diff d ON d.id = c.diffID JOIN phabricator_differential.differential_revision r ON r.id = d.revisionID AND r.activeDiffPHID = d.phid WHERE u.userName = 'alice' AND r.id = 3 LIMIT 1

name: web: an inline draft replying to Bob on D1
sql: INSERT INTO phabricator_differential.differential_transaction_comment (phid, transactionPHID, authorPHID, viewPolicy, editPolicy, commentVersion, content, contentSource, isDeleted, dateCreated, dateModified, revisionPHID, changesetID, isNewFile, lineNumber, lineLength, fixedState, hasReplies, replyToCommentPHID, attributes) SELECT 'PHID-XCMT-paritydraft00001', NULL, u.phid, 'public', u.phid, 1, 'Yes, the spec says so.', '{"source":"web","params":[]}', 0, 1, 1, p.revisionPHID, p.changesetID, p.isNewFile, p.lineNumber, p.lineLength, NULL, 0, p.phid, '{"inline.state":{"text":"Yes","hasSuggestion":false,"suggestionText":""},"editing":false}' FROM phabricator_user.user u, (SELECT * FROM phabricator_differential.differential_transaction_comment WHERE revisionPHID = '{D1}' AND changesetID IS NOT NULL AND transactionPHID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) p WHERE u.userName = 'alice'

sql: INSERT INTO phabricator_differential.differential_transaction_comment (phid, transactionPHID, authorPHID, viewPolicy, editPolicy, commentVersion, content, contentSource, isDeleted, dateCreated, dateModified, revisionPHID, changesetID, isNewFile, lineNumber, lineLength, fixedState, hasReplies, replyToCommentPHID, attributes) SELECT 'PHID-XCMT-paritydraft00001', NULL, u.phid, 'public', u.phid, 1, 'Half writ', '{"source":"web","params":[]}', 0, 1, 1, '{D3}', c.id, 1, 9, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, '{"editing":true}' FROM phabricator_user.user u, phabricator_differential.differential_changeset c JOIN phabricator_differential.differential_diff d ON d.id = c.diffID JOIN phabricator_differential.differential_revision r ON r.id = d.revisionID AND r.activeDiffPHID = d.phid WHERE u.userName = 'alice' AND r.id = 3 LIMIT 1
